name: Mnemoverse
description: Hosted persistent memory for agents: save decisions, preferences and lessons, then recall them in later conversations and in other MCP clients.
notes: Runs the MIT-licensed @mnemoverse/mcp-memory-server package over stdio with an API key. Memory is kept by the hosted Mnemoverse service, not in the sandbox, so it carries over to conversations that start in a fresh runtime. Memory is scoped to the account behind the key, so other MCP clients connected with the same API key reach the same memory. Rating a recalled memory as helpful or misleading re-ranks what comes back next.

envFields.label: Mnemoverse API key
envFields.helperText: Create a key in the Mnemoverse console. The free plan needs no credit card.

installHint: Create a free account at console.mnemoverse.com (no credit card) and paste an API key that starts with mk_live_.
